chapter_seo_title: Chapter 228: Puppets and Cultivators – Han Li’s Divine Wind Boat Nearly Shot Down
chapter_meta_description: Han Li refines the Ink Flood Dragon into a blazing-fast flying boat, but on the return trip a stray pillar of light nearly ends him—and reveals a desperate puppet war below.
og_title: Chapter 228: Puppets and Cultivators – A Stray Beam Changes Everything
og_description: Han Li finally gets his flying speed upgrade, then immediately stumbles into a puppet siege that puts his own survival instincts to the test.
twitter_title: A new boat, a near-miss, and a puppet war – Chapter 228 is pure Mortal Stream gold.
twitter_description: Han Li enjoys a rare moment of triumph with his Divine Wind Boat before nearly getting obliterated by a stray beam. Below, Foundation Establishment cultivators are getting ground down by endless puppets.

lore_anchors.definition: A speed-focused flying artifact refined from Ink Flood Dragon fin and tail; extremely fast but lacks defensive capabilities and passenger capacity.
A second-order evolved demonic beast equivalent to late Foundation Establishment; its materials are highly prized for artifact refinement.
A humanoid puppet that fires multicolored spiritual arrows from a longbow; a common mid-tier automated combat unit.
A construct shaped like a wild animal (tiger, leopard) that can fire elemental beams from its mouth; typically powered by spirit stones.
The second major cultivation realm, marked by the establishment of a stable foundation in the dantian; cultivators at this stage have significantly more mana and lifespan than Qi Condensation.
A legendary minor forbidden array specializing in illusion and concealment; its portable version is a valuable defensive asset even when weakened.
